summary: D16: cut per-PR workflow fan-out: CodeQL off pull_request (main+weekly), fold require-issue-link and rfc-lifecycle-check into ai-sdlc-gate, workflow-level trust if on untrusted-pr-gate and ai-sdlc-review

options.description: CodeQL to main+weekly, fold the two gates into ai-sdlc-gate, workflow-level trust if (planner recommendation)
fold two gates and trust if only; keep CodeQL on PRs
no change; dispatch reruns on quiet hours

body: Every PR push fires 7-8 workflows; at ~32 pushes/90 min their API calls exhaust the repo's GitHub Actions token bucket (1,000 req/hr), so Detect Changes and Require Linked Issue fail with 'API rate limit exceeded for installation' (#1634, 22:31Z and 22:38Z) and reruns burn the same bucket. Branch protection requires only ai-sdlc/pr-ready. Option full moves CodeQL PR scanning to main+weekly (a scan-timing loosening: a vulnerable diff is scanned minutes after landing instead of before; attestation reviewers still gate landing). Continues D1-D15 (DEC-0095..0107).
